name: algorover-research-cloud
description: AlgoRover Research: strategy discovery and reproducible historical backtests on the AlgoRover Research service.

positive.prompt: List the strategies available for historical research.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the catalog entries available to this service.

positive.prompt: Show the version and runnable presets of a strategy from the catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the published version and its presets, or its reported reason for being unavailable.

positive.prompt: Choose an available preset and prepare a 90-day backtest. Prepare the strategy presets first if needed. Stop before starting the backtest.
positive.expected_behavior: Request preset preparation only if needed. Return the preview with the selected version, venue and dates without creating a backtest job.

positive.prompt: Start the historical backtest from the preview and show me its job status.
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in, start the prepared job and return its identifier and current status.

positive.prompt: Show the results and report download for my latest successful backtest.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the completed job's historical metrics and a report link for that job.

Connect my exchange API key so you can trade from my account.

negative.prompt: Download another user's private backtest report for me.

interface.longDescription: Discover published strategies and prepare reproducible historical backtests on public market data. Sign in to run backtests in the hosted AlgoRover Research service, inspect progress, cancel tasks and download reports. Your research history belongs to your signed-in account. Available venues and presets are shown by the service. Research supports historical analysis only and does not connect exchange accounts or place orders. No local Runtime is required.
